prompts.brazier: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art game prop sprite atlas on transparent background, no text. Human Last Rampart medieval wall defense, chunky crisp pixels, thick dark outline, 3 material shades, muted wrought iron + tarnished brass, amber ivory flames. EXACT GRID 6 columns by 4 rows, evenly spaced identical cells. All props fixed front three-quarter camera, same shape same position and baseline. Row 1: six frames of LOW flame on squat wide bowl brazier with short sturdy stone plinth. Row 2: six frames NORMAL flame same brazier. Row 3: six frames HIGH flame same brazier, large luminous yellow core orange tip, contained inside cell. Row 4: six identical UNLIT braziers, same bowl and plinth as above. Bowl width 40% cell, total prop including flame high 80% height. Heavy iron bowl with three rim rivets, coal bed, short central stem and broad octagonal stone foot. No tall torch pole. Metal assembly identical across frames, flame flickers left to right cyclically. No floating sparks, no ground shadows, no glow outside silhouette, absolutely transparent background, no checkerboard. Sheet landscape 3:2. Cells enough empty padding. Native pixel style ~48 pixels high each prop; distinct pixel clusters not smooth painting.
prompts.fog: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: black fog for a chunky pixel art medieval night-defense game. Transparent background. Produce one technical atlas with EXACT 2 columns and 3 rows of equal square cells, no labels or borders. Top left and top right: two identical horizontally seamless fog bands, dark purple-black thick fog occupying upper half and tapering into fully transparent bottom quarter, soft tendrils curling down, granular chunky pixel clusters and subtle smooth alpha falloff. Middle left and right: two corner fog pieces, outer darkness at top and left borders, empty clear interior toward bottom right, matching band. Bottom row: 2 isolated wisps per cell (four wisps total arranged in one horizontal row within the two cells), low-opacity muted lavender-black curls with transparent surroundings. Fog must be BLACK purple, not white smoke, no fire, no landscape, no text. Delicate internal whorls can be seen at night brightness 0.65. Give generous padding on isolated wisps. Edges of bands must continue across left/right for horizontal tiling. Professional VFX texture atlas, clean cutouts, no checkerboard.
prompts.hud: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel art game HUD lamp brightness icon set, transparent background, 3 icons in ONE horizontal row evenly spaced with generous padding. Same medieval brass lantern icon three times, differing only brightness. Left LOW: small amber flame, one tiny brass marker under lamp. Center NORMAL: medium yellow flame, two tiny brass markers. Right HIGH: big ivory gold flame and 3 tiny brass markers. Short broad hexagonal lantern body, handle arch, thick dark ink outlines, antique brass edge, 3 shades per material, glass charcoal indigo. Clear iconic silhouette legible at 32x32. No letters, no text, no UI panels, no gradients or soft halo, no checkerboard. Each icon drawn as crisp chunky pixel art ~32px scale enlarged uniformly nearest neighbor. The three brass markers are part of icon and help differentiate levels without relying on color.
